title: Quasi-Concave Game
body_html:
Quasi-Concave Game

Assume each strategy set $S_i$ is a convex subset of a topological vector space. A strategic game is quasi-concave if, for every player $i$ and every fixed $s_{-i}$, the function $$ s_i\mapsto g_i(s_i,s_{-i}) $$ is quasi-concave on $S_i$.
